title: PAIR WITH BLUETOOTH
caption:
Move this account to a nearby phone on the Basic welcome screen.
Wallets, nsec, and the backup passphrase (if cloud backup is on) transfer over encrypted Bluetooth. Passkeys are not transferred.
If this phone already has Nostr or Home backup, the new phone gets backup fully active. If not, the new phone will remind you to set one up.
step1: Open Basic on the new device and tap pair.
step2: Grant Bluetooth, then match the code shown there.
step3: Tap Start scan here, confirm the same code, then biometrics.
codeHint: Must match the code on the new phone before you approve.
noWalletBody: Create or restore a wallet before pairing.
blePermBody: Allow Bluetooth (and nearby devices) for Basic so it can scan and pair.
statusPassphrase: Enter your backup passphrase to continue pairing…
statusCompare: Compare this code with the new phone, then approve.
authApprove: Approve pairing code %{code}? This unlocks your wallets on the other device.
cancelledPass: Pairing cancelled — backup passphrase was not entered.
